source_category: # A rule is one tag ("tourism=museum") or several joined with + that must all be present
# ("amenity=place_of_worship+religion=shinto"). A place takes the FIRST rule

category: so more specific rules come first. "exclude" drops the place on purpose.

source_category: # The Overpass query is generated from the first tag of every rule that is not "exclude"
# decides both what is fetched and how it is mapped. Lines starting with # are comments.
